generator_cmd:
bash gen.sh OUT (printf payloads, Pillow PNG, zip -X -j inner zip; manifest claims from stat -c %s + sha256sum; dirty tree mutated after the manifest + jq lies; zip -q -X -r): #!/bin/bash
# gen.sh <outdir>: builds clean/ and dirty/ cluster trees + zips with printf, Pillow (PNG), zip CLI, sha256sum/stat (manifest claims)
set -e
O=$1; cd $O
mk() { # $1 dir
  mkdir -p $1/artifacts; cd $1/artifacts
  printf 'Huntress cluster note\nmarker=P-01\n' > alpha-01.txt; cp alpha-01.txt alpha-02.txt
  printf 'Write-Output "beacon"\n' > bravo-01.ps1; cp bravo-01.ps1 bravo-02.ps1
  printf '{"k":"v","n":1}\n' > charlie-01.json; cp charlie-01.json charlie-02.json
  python3 -c 'from PIL import Image; Image.new("RGB",(4,3),(9,8,7)).save("delta-01.png")'; cp delta-01.png delta-02.png
  printf 'inner\n' > /tmp/inner_$$.txt; (cd /tmp && zip -q -X -j $OLDPWD/echo-01.zip inner_$$.txt); rm /tmp/inner_$$.txt; cp echo-01.zip echo-02.zip
  cd ../..
}
claim() { # dir id file ctype family producer -> json object line using real sha/size (claims TRUE)
  f=$1/artifacts/$3; printf '{"id":"%s","filename":"%s","path":"artifacts/%s","content_type":"%s","family":"%s","producer_id":"%s","size_bytes":%s,"sha256":"%s"}' \
    $2 $3 $3 $4 $5 $6 $(stat -c %s $f) $(sha256sum $f | cut -c1-64)
}
manifest() { # dir -> prints manifest built from current files, then caller mutates
  d=$1; echo -n '{"schema":"huntress.artifact_delivery_manifest.v1","artifacts":['
  claim $d alpha-01 alpha-01.txt text/plain text text_template; echo -n ,
  claim $d alpha-02 alpha-02.txt text/plain text duplicate_ref; echo -n ,
  claim $d bravo-01 bravo-01.ps1 text/plain script text_template; echo -n ,
  claim $d bravo-02 bravo-02.ps1 text/plain script duplicate_ref; echo -n ,
  claim $d charlie-01 charlie-01.json application/json json text_template; echo -n ,
  claim $d charlie-02 charlie-02.json application/json json duplicate_ref; echo -n ,
  claim $d delta-01 delta-01.png image/png png structured_image; echo -n ,
  claim $d delta-02 delta-02.png image/png png duplicate_ref; echo -n ,
  claim $d echo-01 echo-01.zip application/zip zip structured_zip; echo -n ,
  claim $d echo-02 echo-02.zip application/zip zip duplicate_ref
  echo ']}'
}
# clean: all claims true
mk clean; manifest clean > clean/delivery-manifest.json
# dirty
mk dirty; manifest dirty > dirty/m.json
cd dirty/artifacts
printf 'Huntress cluster note\nmarker=P-0X\n' > alpha-02.txt          # same size, new bytes: sha claim false, dup_ref unsupported
printf 'Write-Output "beacon!!"\n' > bravo-02.ps1                    # size+sha claim false, dup_ref unsupported
printf 'not json at all\n' > charlie-02.json                         # ctype application/json false, family json false, size/sha false, dup unsupported
rm echo-02.zip                                                       # missing
printf 'unclaimed\n' > foxtrot-01.txt                                # unlisted
cd ../..
# lie about content_type of delta-02 (claim text/plain on a PNG) and family of bravo-01 (claim zip on a script)
jq -c '.artifacts |= map(if .id=="delta-02" then .content_type="text/plain" elif .id=="bravo-01" then .family="zip" else . end)' dirty/m.json > dirty/delivery-manifest.json; rm dirty/m.json
touch -d '2026-10-01 00:00:00' clean/artifacts/* clean/*.json dirty/artifacts/* dirty/*.json
(cd clean && zip -q -X -r ../cluster-101.zip delivery-manifest.json artifacts)
(cd dirty && zip -q -X -r ../cluster-102.zip delivery-manifest.json artifacts)
(cd dirty && zip -q -X -r ../cluster-103.zip artifacts)     # decoy: no manifest
oracle_cmd:
bash oracle.sh <extracted tree> (jq + sha256sum + stat + file -b --mime-type; dup_ref vs non-duplicate_ref producers; find vs manifest paths): #!/bin/bash
# oracle.sh <tree-dir>: unzip-free check over the extracted tree with jq + sha256sum + stat + file --mime-type
d=$1; m=$d/delivery-manifest.json
[ -f $m ] || { echo NO_MANIFEST; exit; }
jq -r '.artifacts[]|[.id,.path,.content_type,.family,.producer_id,.size_bytes,.sha256]|@tsv' $m | while IFS=$'\t' read id p ct fam prod sz sh; do
  f=$d/$p; if [ ! -f $f ]; then echo "missing $id"; continue; fi
  [ "$(sha256sum $f|cut -c1-64)" = "$sh" ] || echo "sha $id"
  [ "$(stat -c %s $f)" = "$sz" ] || echo "size $id"
  mt=$(file -b --mime-type $f)
  case $ct in text/plain) [ "$mt" = text/plain ] || [ "$mt" = application/json ] || echo "ctype $id ($mt)";; *) [ "$mt" = "$ct" ] || echo "ctype $id ($mt)";; esac
  case $fam in png) [ "$mt" = image/png ] || echo "family $id";; zip) [ "$mt" = application/zip ] || echo "family $id";; json) jq -e . $f >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "family $id";; text|script) [[ $mt == text/* || $mt == application/json ]] || echo "family $id";; esac
  if [ "$prod" = duplicate_ref ]; then s=$(sha256sum $f|cut -c1-64); ok=0
    for o in $(jq -r '.artifacts[]|select(.producer_id!="duplicate_ref")|.path' $m); do [ -f $d/$o ] && [ "$(sha256sum $d/$o|cut -c1-64)" = "$s" ] && ok=1; done
    [ $ok = 1 ] || echo "dupref $id"; fi
done
for f in $(cd $d && find . -type f ! -name delivery-manifest.json | sed 's|^\./||'); do jq -e --arg p "$f" 'any(.artifacts[]; .path==$p)' $m >/dev/null || echo "unlisted $(basename $f)"; done
